warnings: This is a STRUCTURAL roof framing plan (purlins + rafters with member sizes and spacing over the main grid) — classified pattern:'plan' per the schema's roof_plan-vs-plan rule, NOT 'roof_plan' (that pattern is reserved for the architectural ridge/eave/roofing-material sheet, which is out of op04's Pass-2 scope).

Purlins (แป) run continuously across the whole roof at 1.50m centres, perpendicular to the ridge — they are not individually marked, so per schema §6a they are recorded as ONE spacing-based member type (spacing_mm:1500) covering the roof plan area, rather than atomizing ~9-10 individual unmarked runs.

Roof geometry: overall roof envelope is 15.40m x 15.40m (13.00m main grid + 1.20m eave overhang on all 4 sides, per the printed dimension chain) with a ridge line offset 1.20m to the right/below of grid 2 on both axes — this reads as a hip roof with an off-centre ridge, but the exact hip-line layout is not fully resolvable from the plan view alone at this scan resolution (no elevation/roof_plan-architectural sheet is in op04's scope to cross-check).

Two rafter (จันทัน) leader callouts are printed (top-left and top-right of the plan) for the same size ⊏-125x65x6x8mm — recorded as one rafter spec applied wherever จันทัน appears; exact rafter count/run lines are not individually traceable from this plan view.
